movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Pluck
movelist.effect: Pluck takes the target’s Held Item or Accessory Slot Item and attaches it to Pluck’s user, if the user is not holding anything.

abilities.name: Defeatist
abilities.effect: The user gain a +2d6 Bonus to Damage Rolls while over 50% of its Maximum Hit Points. While at 50% Max Hit Points or lower, the user gains a -5 penalty to Damage Rolls and +10 Initiative.

abilities.name: Frighten
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.
